column1: # Sources whose annotator message differs from the Elixir under test's by design, as <hash>\t<Elixir versions>.
# The annotators give each release its own wording, except where that release crashes or names
# only the token its parser failed on; those releases are listed here with the message of the next release.
# `unexpected space between % and {`: before 1.15 Elixir reports only a syntax error whose position depends on what follows.
# An invalid escape in a quoted call name: 1.18 raises a MatchError while unescaping it; the annotators give 1.19's message.
# From 1.12 an invalid escape inside a closed interpolation of an unterminated heredoc fails before its missing terminator; the plugin reports both.
# Elixir's tokenizer rejects a word first, so its parser never reaches the construct the plugin also reports there.
# `do:` after a number: the annotation keeps the first sentence of Elixir's message, whose first line runs into its example.
